_comment: Seed config. Copied to /data/config.json on first start, then never overwritten - edit the copy on the server. Telegram credentials come from the .env file, not from here.

filters._exclude_note: Only non-cars plus the Changan Ben Ben / Benni / E-Star. Small EVs such as the BYD Seagull are wanted and must NOT be listed here.
filters._min_mileage_note: 0 disables the check. Set to 1 to hide '0 km' dealer/import ads - that was previously dropping ~120 listings per scan.
filters._powertrain_note: All fuel types are accepted - petrol, diesel, hybrid and electric.
